_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: C++ Institute, CPE - C++ Certified Entry-Level Programmer, exam CPE-20-01 (active version of CPE-20-0x): exam syllabus on the certification page
_items_source.numbering: Ids are the C++ Institute's own objective numbers (1.1-4.5); each numbered objective is one item.

_syllabus_items.title: Valid C++ syntax elements, keywords and code structure
Built-in data types and their literals
Structure and declaration of main() and its parameters
Arithmetic, relational, logical, bitwise and assignment operators
Operator precedence and associativity, and their effect on expressions
Short-circuit evaluation in control expressions
Basic I/O streams cin, cout, cerr and manipulators endl, setw
Conditional statements if and else
Loops while, do and for; break and continue
The goto statement and labelled statements
Multiple selection with switch, case and default
Defining, declaring and calling functions
return in typed and void functions
Passing arguments by value, by reference and by pointer
Basic recursion
Vectors and arrays, including multidimensional arrays
Accessing vector data through data()
Declaring and initialising pointers, including nullptr
Dereferencing and the address-of operator &
Pointer conversions with static_cast and dynamic_cast
Dynamic memory with new, delete and delete[]
Declaring and defining structures
Accessing structure members with the dot operator
Vectors of structures and their fields
Declaring, initialising and changing std::string objects
Basic string operations and comparisons
